fix_subject: Do not use the one-pass optimization on an UPDATE if there is a subquery in the WHERE clause, since if the subquery is hidden behind a short-circuit operator, the subquery might not be evaluated until after one or more rows have been updated.  Fix for the problem reported by [forum:/forumpost/0007d1fdb1|forum post 0007d1fdb1].  This is the same problem that was fixed by [73f0036f045bf371] only for UPDATE instead of DELETE.
